notes.title: Zap Dem Rats Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Zap Dem Rats Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Version S 1.05[/h2]

[h3]Change Log[/h3]

Includes changes from version S 1.04 

Replaced image and voice for menu tutorial

Added stepped skipping for tutorial. Players who select skip before or during keyboard tutorial will now be prompted with the menu tutorial. Players can click anywhere again to skip the menu tutorial.

Fixed issue which would sometimes cause Vote Today to go out of sequence.

Fixed shader on Vote Early... Vote Often... Arrows to remove diffuse around transparent image.

Corrected Nav Mesh and transitional linking in Capitol

notes.title: Zap Dem Rats Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Zap Dem Rats Patch Notes[/h1]
[h2]Version S 1.01[/h2]

[h3]Change Log[/h3]

New hidden coins added to 2A

Added blockade on Pennsylvania in 2A to help direct players and prevent confusion.

Adapted some building mesh colliders that were preventing direct shots from hitting zombies in some areas.

Updated 2A, Vote Today, Media City, & Woke U maps to fill horizon background better.

New road signs above Pennsylvania Avenue to help direct players at transition locations.

Fixed depot sign - No success sound on load of 2a and replacement sign now displays correctly.

Navmesh updated with new boundary control in 2A

Mission 1 NPC doubling in Cheetas corrected.

Added objectives completed notification to 2A(To follow on remaining areas)

Removed Interdimensional Portal from Tommy's Garage in Vote Today - to much confusion for new players who stumble upon it.

Updated Keyboard control screen during intro and menu.
